title: Sending Out the Twelve

bsb: These twelve Jesus sent out with the following instructions:
kjv: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying,

puzzle.hint: Share what God has given you.

bsb: Freely you have received; freely give.
kjv: freely ye have received, freely give.

bsb: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.
kjv: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

puzzles.prompt: Jesus talked about sparrows sold at the market.
puzzles.question: How many sparrows were sold for a penny?

puzzles.prompt: Jesus said you are worth more than many…
puzzles.hint: God cares even for the smallest birds, and you matter more.

bsb: Freely you have received; freely give.
kjv: freely ye have received, freely give.

reflect: Jesus sent His disciples to share what they had been given. God knows even the number of hairs on your head.
discuss: Jesus said, “Freely you have received; freely give.” What has God given you that you can share?
God knows when a single sparrow falls. How does it feel to know He knows everything about you?
Jesus said even a cup of cold water given in His name matters. What small kind thing could you do this week?
prayer: Father, thank You for knowing and caring for us. You have given us so much. Help us freely give to others. Amen.
